learning citywide patterns of life from.subject: patterns of life analysis
learning citywide patterns of life from.claim: Patterns of life analysis is formally defined as a natural, explainable extension of online unsupervised anomaly detection that explicitly extracts normal patterns over time.
learning citywide patterns of life from.quote: We formally define patterns of life analysis as a natural, explainable extension of online unsupervised anomaly detection, where we not only monitor a data stream for anomalies but also explicitly extract normal patterns over time.

learning citywide patterns of life from.subject: Grow When Required (GWR) episodic memory
learning citywide patterns of life from.claim: The authors adapt Grow When Required (GWR) episodic memory, a biologically-inspired neural network related to self-organizing maps, to the domain of geospatial analysis to learn patterns of life.
learning citywide patterns of life from.quote: To learn patterns of life, we adapt Grow When Required (GWR) episodic memory from research in computational biology and neurorobotics to a new domain of geospatial analysis. This biologically-inspired neural network, related to self-organizing maps (SOM), constructs a set of "memories" or prototype traffic patterns incrementally as it iterates over the GPS stream.

learning citywide patterns of life from.subject: Porto taxi dataset
learning citywide patterns of life from.claim: The study mined patterns-of-interest from the Porto taxi dataset, including major public holidays and newly-discovered transportation anomalies such as festivals and concerts.
learning citywide patterns of life from.quote: We mine patterns-of-interest from the Porto taxi dataset, including both major public holidays and newly-discovered transportation anomalies, such as festivals and concerts which, to our knowledge, have not been previously acknowledged or reported in prior work.

lifelong person re identification by pse.subject: pseudo task knowledge preservation framework
lifelong person re identification by pse.claim: The authors propose a pseudo task knowledge preservation framework to alleviate the domain gap in lifelong person re-identification.
lifelong person re identification by pse.quote: To overcome this problem, we cast LReID as a domain adaptation problem and propose a pseudo task knowledge preservation framework to alleviate the domain gap.

lifelong person re identification by pse.subject: pseudo task transformation module
lifelong person re identification by pse.claim: The framework uses a pseudo task transformation module to map features of new tasks into the feature space of old tasks to complement limited saved exemplars.
lifelong person re identification by pse.quote: Our framework is based on a pseudo task transformation module which maps the features of the new task into the feature space of the old tasks to complement the limited saved exemplars of the old tasks.

lifelong person re identification by pse.subject: task-specific domain consistency loss
lifelong person re identification by pse.claim: A task-specific domain consistency loss is proposed to implicitly alleviate the task-wise domain gap for learning task-shared knowledge.
lifelong person re identification by pse.quote: With extra transformed features in the task-specific feature space, we propose a task-specific domain consistency loss to implicitly alleviate the task-wise domain gap for learning task-shared knowledge instead of task-specific one.

lifelong person re identification by pse.subject: LReID
lifelong person re identification by pse.claim: Task-wise domain gap is a key factor for catastrophic forgetting in lifelong person re-identification that is ignored in existing approaches.
lifelong person re identification by pse.quote: In addition to missing data from the old tasks, task-wise domain gap is a key factor for catastrophic forgetting in LReID, which is ignored in existing approaches for LReID.

lifelong person re identification by pse.subject: pseudo task knowledge preservation framework
lifelong person re identification by pse.claim: Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method compared with state-of-the-art lifelong learning and LReID methods.
lifelong person re identification by pse.quote: Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our method as compared with the state-of-the-art lifelong learning and LReID methods.

climb a continual learning benchmark for.subject: CLiMB
climb a continual learning benchmark for.claim: CLiMB is a benchmark presented to study the challenge of learning multimodal tasks in a continual learning setting and to systematically evaluate how upstream continual learning can rapidly generalize to new multimodal and unimodal tasks.
climb a continual learning benchmark for.quote: We present CLiMB, a benchmark to study the challenge of learning multimodal tasks in a CL setting, and to systematically evaluate how upstream continual learning can rapidly generalize to new multimodal and unimodal tasks.

climb a continual learning benchmark for.subject: ViLT
climb a continual learning benchmark for.claim: CLiMB includes a modified Vision-Language Transformer (ViLT) model that can be deployed on both multimodal and unimodal tasks.
climb a continual learning benchmark for.quote: CLiMB includes implementations of several CL algorithms and a modified Vision-Language Transformer (ViLT) model that can be deployed on both multimodal and unimodal tasks.

climb a continual learning benchmark for.subject: common CL methods
climb a continual learning benchmark for.claim: Common continual learning methods can help mitigate forgetting during multimodal task learning.
climb a continual learning benchmark for.quote: We find that common CL methods can help mitigate forgetting during multimodal task learning, but do not enable cross-task knowledge transfer.

climb a continual learning benchmark for.subject: common CL methods
climb a continual learning benchmark for.claim: Common continual learning methods do not enable cross-task knowledge transfer in the multimodal setting.
climb a continual learning benchmark for.quote: We find that common CL methods can help mitigate forgetting during multimodal task learning, but do not enable cross-task knowledge transfer.

climb a continual learning benchmark for.subject: Existing CL benchmarks
climb a continual learning benchmark for.claim: Existing continual learning benchmarks are limited to vision-only and language-only tasks.
climb a continual learning benchmark for.quote: Existing CL benchmarks have facilitated research on task adaptation and mitigating"catastrophic forgetting", but are limited to vision-only and language-only tasks.

fashionvlp vision language transformer f.subject: FashionVLP
fashionvlp vision language transformer f.claim: FashionVLP is a new vision-language transformer based model that brings prior knowledge from large image-text corpora to fashion image retrieval and combines visual information from multiple levels of context.
fashionvlp vision language transformer f.quote: We propose a new vision-language transformer based model, FashionVLP, that brings the prior knowledge contained in large image-text corpora to the domain of fashion image retrieval, and combines visual information from multiple levels of context to effectively capture fashion-related information.

fashionvlp vision language transformer f.subject: FashionVLP
fashionvlp vision language transformer f.claim: The model uses an asymmetric design that adopts a novel attention-based approach for fusing target image features without involving text or transformer layers in the process.
fashionvlp vision language transformer f.quote: While queries are encoded through the transformer layers, our asymmetric design adopts a novel attention-based approach for fusing target image features without involving text or transformer layers in the process.

fashionvlp vision language transformer f.subject: FashionVLP
fashionvlp vision language transformer f.claim: FashionVLP achieves state-of-the-art performance on benchmark datasets, including a 23% relative improvement on the FashionIQ dataset.
fashionvlp vision language transformer f.quote: Extensive results show that FashionVLP achieves the state-of-the-art performance on benchmark datasets, with a large 23% relative improvement on the challenging FashionIQ dataset, which contains complex natural language feedback.

geometer graph few shot class incrementa.subject: Geometer
geometer graph few shot class incrementa.claim: Geometer is a novel method for graph few-shot class-incremental learning that predicts node labels by finding the nearest class prototype instead of retraining a fully connected classifier.
geometer graph few shot class incrementa.quote: In this paper, we focus on this challenging but practical graph few-shot class-incremental learning (GFSCIL) problem and propose a novel method called Geometer. Instead of replacing and retraining the fully connected neural network classifier, Geometer predicts the label of a node by finding the nearest class prototype.

geometer graph few shot class incrementa.subject: Geometer
geometer graph few shot class incrementa.claim: Geometer learns and adjusts attention-based prototypes by observing geometric proximity, uniformity, and separability as novel classes appear.
geometer graph few shot class incrementa.quote: With the pop-up of novel classes, Geometer learns and adjusts the attention-based prototypes by observing the geometric proximity, uniformity and separability.

geometer graph few shot class incrementa.subject: Geometer
geometer graph few shot class incrementa.claim: Geometer introduces teacher-student knowledge distillation and biased sampling to mitigate catastrophic forgetting and unbalanced labeling problems, respectively.
geometer graph few shot class incrementa.quote: Teacher-student knowledge distillation and biased sampling are further introduced to mitigate catastrophic forgetting and unbalanced labeling problem respectively.

geometer graph few shot class incrementa.subject: Geometer
geometer graph few shot class incrementa.claim: Geometer achieves a substantial improvement of 9.46% to 27.60% over state-of-the-art methods on four public datasets.
geometer graph few shot class incrementa.quote: Experimental results on four public datasets demonstrate that Geometer achieves a substantial improvement of 9.46% to 27.60% over state-of-the-art methods.

large scale meta heuristic feature selec.subject: RH-BPSO
large scale meta heuristic feature selec.claim: A novel global search method for numerical feature selection is proposed based on the hybridization of the rough hypercuboid approach and binary particle swarm optimization (BPSO) algorithm.
large scale meta heuristic feature selec.quote: By integrating the meta-heuristic-based evolutionary search technique, a novel global search method for numerical feature selection is proposed in this article based on the hybridization of the rough hypercuboid approach and binary particle swarm optimization (BPSO) algorithm, namely RH-BPSO.

large scale meta heuristic feature selec.subject: DiRH-BPSO
large scale meta heuristic feature selec.claim: A distributed meta-heuristic optimized rough hypercuboid feature selection algorithm is developed and embedded in the Apache Spark cloud computing model to alleviate high computational costs on large-scale datasets.
large scale meta heuristic feature selec.quote: A distributed meta-heuristic optimized rough hypercuboid feature selection (DiRH-BPSO) algorithm is thus developed and embedded in the Apache Spark cloud computing model.

large scale meta heuristic feature selec.subject: RH-BPSO
large scale meta heuristic feature selec.claim: RH-BPSO significantly outperforms other representative feature selection algorithms in terms of classification accuracy, the cardinality of the selected feature subset, and execution efficiency.
large scale meta heuristic feature selec.quote: Extensive experimental results indicate that RH-BPSO is promising and can significantly outperform the other representative feature selection algorithms in terms of classification accuracy, the cardinality of the selected feature subset, and execution efficiency.

large scale meta heuristic feature selec.subject: DiRH-BPSO
large scale meta heuristic feature selec.claim: DiRH-BPSO is significantly faster than its sequential counterpart and is capable of completing large-scale feature selection tasks that fail on a single node due to memory constraints.
large scale meta heuristic feature selec.quote: Moreover, experiments on distributed-memory multicore clusters show that DiRH-BPSO is significantly faster than its sequential counterpart and is perfectly capable of completing large-scale feature selection tasks that fail on a single node due to memory constraints.

large scale meta heuristic feature selec.subject: DiRH-BPSO
large scale meta heuristic feature selec.claim: DiRH-BPSO scales out and extends well with the growth of computational nodes and the volume of data.
large scale meta heuristic feature selec.quote: Parallel scalability and extensibility analysis also demonstrate that DiRH-BPSO could scale out and extend well with the growth of computational nodes and the volume of data.

forget less count better a domain increm.subject: FLCB
forget less count better a domain increm.claim: The authors propose a self-distillation learning framework called FLCB as a benchmark for lifelong crowd counting to mitigate forgetting when new data arrive.
forget less count better a domain increm.quote: Specifically, we propose a self-distillation learning framework as a benchmark (forget less, count better, or FLCB) for lifelong crowd counting, which helps the model leverage previous meaningful knowledge in a sustainable manner for better crowd counting to mitigate the forgetting when new data arrive.

forget less count better a domain increm.subject: nBwT
forget less count better a domain increm.claim: A new quantitative metric, normalized Backward Transfer (nBwT), is developed to evaluate the forgetting degree of the model in the lifelong learning process.
forget less count better a domain increm.quote: A new quantitative metric, normalized Backward Transfer (nBwT), is developed to evaluate the forgetting degree of the model in the lifelong learning process.

forget less count better a domain increm.subject: FLCB
forget less count better a domain increm.claim: Extensive experimental results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed benchmark in achieving a low catastrophic forgetting degree and strong generalization ability.
forget less count better a domain increm.quote: Extensive experimental results demonstrate the superiority of our proposed benchmark in achieving a low catastrophic forgetting degree and strong generalization ability.

forget less count better a domain increm.subject: Off-the-shelf methods
forget less count better a domain increm.claim: Off-the-shelf methods suffer from limited performance or dramatic drops in old domains after training on new domains due to catastrophic forgetting.
forget less count better a domain increm.quote: Off-the-shelf methods have some drawbacks when handling multiple domains: (1) the models will achieve limited performance (even drop dramatically) among old domains after training images from new domains due to the discrepancies in intrinsic data distributions from various domains, which is called catastrophic forgetting;

forget less count better a domain increm.subject: Off-the-shelf methods
forget less count better a domain increm.claim: Well-trained models in a specific domain achieve imperfect performance among other unseen domains because of domain shift.
forget less count better a domain increm.quote: (2) the well-trained model in a specific domain achieves imperfect performance among other unseen domains because of domain shift;

forget less count better a domain increm.subject: Off-the-shelf methods
forget less count better a domain increm.claim: Handling new domains leads to linearly increasing storage overhead when mixing all data for training or training separate models for different domains.
forget less count better a domain increm.quote: (3) it leads to linearly increasing storage overhead, either mixing all the data for training or simply training dozens of separate models for different domains when new ones are available.

continual learning for peer to peer fede.subject: Continual learning for peer-to-peer federated learning
continual learning for peer to peer fede.claim: Continual learning can promote multicenter collaboration on deep learning algorithm development by sharing intermediate models instead of training data to bypass data privacy restrictions.
continual learning for peer to peer fede.quote: Continual learning, as one approach to peer-to-peer federated learning, can promote multicenter collaboration on deep learning algorithm development by sharing intermediate models instead of training data to bypass data privacy restrictions.

continual learning for peer to peer fede.subject: DeepMedic
continual learning for peer to peer fede.claim: The DeepMedic neural network is trained for brain metastasis segmentation.
continual learning for peer to peer fede.quote: The DeepMedic neural network is trained for brain metastasis segmentation.

continual learning for peer to peer fede.subject: Synaptic Intelligence (SI)
continual learning for peer to peer fede.claim: A continual learning algorithm, synaptic intelligence (SI), is applied to preserve important model weights for training one center after another.
continual learning for peer to peer fede.quote: A continual learning algorithm, synaptic intelligence (SI), is applied to preserve important model weights for training one center after another.

continual learning for peer to peer fede.subject: Continual learning with SI
continual learning for peer to peer fede.claim: In a bilateral collaboration scenario, continual learning with SI achieves a sensitivity of 0.917, which is higher than naive continual learning (0.906) and models trained on internal data solely (0.853 and 0.831).
continual learning for peer to peer fede.quote: In a bilateral collaboration scenario, continual learning with SI achieves a sensitivity of 0.917, and naive continual learning without SI achieves a sensitivity of 0.906, while two models trained on internal data solely without continual learning achieve sensitivity of 0.853 and 0.831 only.

continual learning for peer to peer fede.subject: Iterative continual learning
continual learning for peer to peer fede.claim: With iterative continual learning, the sensitivity is further improved to 0.914, which is identical to the sensitivity using mixed data for training.
continual learning for peer to peer fede.quote: With iterative continual learning (i.e., the shared model revisits each center multiple times during training), the sensitivity is further improved to 0.914, which is identical to the sensitivity using mixed data for training.

continual learning for peer to peer fede.subject: Continual learning for peer-to-peer federated learning
continual learning for peer to peer fede.claim: Experiments demonstrate the feasibility of applying continual learning for peer-to-peer federated learning in multicenter collaboration.
continual learning for peer to peer fede.quote: Our experiments demonstrate the feasibility of applying continual learning for peer-to-peer federated learning in multicenter collaboration.

fire fast incremental recommendation wit.subject: FIRE
fire fast incremental recommendation wit.claim: FIRE is a non-parametric method that does not suffer from time-consuming back-propagations, significantly improving the efficiency of model updating.
fire fast incremental recommendation wit.quote: FIRE is non-parametric which does not suffer from the time-consuming back-propagations as in previous learning-based methods, significantly improving the efficiency of model updating.

fire fast incremental recommendation wit.subject: FIRE
fire fast incremental recommendation wit.claim: FIRE encodes user/item temporal information and side information by designing new graph filters to capture temporal dynamics and address the cold-start issue.
fire fast incremental recommendation wit.quote: In addition, we encode user/item temporal information and side information by designing new graph filters in FIRE, which can capture the temporal dynamics of users/items and address the cold-start issue for new users/items, respectively.

fire fast incremental recommendation wit.subject: FIRE
fire fast incremental recommendation wit.claim: FIRE improves accuracy by a large margin and improves model updating efficiency by at least 3X compared with state-of-the-art incremental recommendation algorithms.
fire fast incremental recommendation wit.quote: Experimental studies on four popular datasets demonstrate that FIRE can improve the accuracy by a large margin and improve the model updating efficiency by at least 3X compared with the state-of-the-art incremental recommendation algorithms.

fire fast incremental recommendation wit.subject: previous learning-based methods
fire fast incremental recommendation wit.claim: Previous learning-based methods for incremental recommendation are faced with the challenge that model training and/or updating are time-consuming.
fire fast incremental recommendation wit.quote: However, these methods are faced with two key challenges: 1) model training and/or updating are time-consuming and 2) new users/items cannot be effectively handled.

fire fast incremental recommendation wit.subject: previous learning-based methods
fire fast incremental recommendation wit.claim: Previous learning-based methods for incremental recommendation cannot effectively handle new users or items.
fire fast incremental recommendation wit.quote: However, these methods are faced with two key challenges: 1) model training and/or updating are time-consuming and 2) new users/items cannot be effectively handled.

an incremental learning approach to pred.subject: incremental learning approach
an incremental learning approach to pred.claim: The paper proposes an approach based on incremental learning to build predictive models of the SEIRD variables for the COVID-19 pandemic.
an incremental learning approach to pred.quote: In this paper, we propose an approach based on incremental learning to build predictive models of the SEIRD variables for the COVID-19 pandemic.

an incremental learning approach to pred.subject: dynamic ensemble method
an incremental learning approach to pred.claim: The incremental learning approach is a dynamic ensemble method based on a bagging scheme that allows the addition of new models or the updating of incremental models.
an incremental learning approach to pred.quote: Our incremental learning approach is a dynamic ensemble method based on a bagging scheme that allows the addition of new models or the updating of incremental models.

an incremental learning approach to pred.subject: incremental learning architecture
an incremental learning approach to pred.claim: The proposed architecture is composed of two components: one for analyzing interdependencies of SEIRD variables and another for building or updating predictive models.
an incremental learning approach to pred.quote: The article proposes an incremental learning architecture composed of two components. The first component carries out an analysis of the interdependencies of the SEIRD variables and the second component is an incremental learning model that builds/updates the predictive models.

an incremental learning approach to pred.subject: incremental learning approach
an incremental learning approach to pred.claim: The analysis of the quality of the predictive models using data from Colombia shows interesting results about the predictions of the SEIRD variables.
an incremental learning approach to pred.quote: The paper analyses the quality of the predictive models of our incremental learning approach using data of the COVID-19 from Colombia, and shows interesting results about the predictions of the SEIRD variables.

an incremental learning approach to pred.subject: incremental learning approach
an incremental learning approach to pred.claim: The results of the proposed approach are compared with an incremental learning approach based on random forests.
an incremental learning approach to pred.quote: These results are compared with an incremental learning approach based on random forests.

multimodal continual graph learning with.subject: MSCGL
multimodal continual graph learning with.claim: The paper proposes a novel Multimodal Structure-evolving Continual Graph Learning (MSCGL) model that continually learns both the model architecture and the corresponding parameters for Adaptive Multimodal Graph Neural Network (AdaMGNN).
multimodal continual graph learning with.quote: To tackle these challenges, in this paper we propose a novel Multimodal Structure-evolving Continual Graph Learning (MSCGL) model, which continually learns both the model architecture and the corresponding parameters for Adaptive Multimodal Graph Neural Network (AdaMGNN).

multimodal continual graph learning with.subject: MSCGL
multimodal continual graph learning with.claim: The MSCGL model explores a new strategy with joint optimization of Neural Architecture Search (NAS) and Group Sparse Regularization (GSR) across different tasks to continually adapt to new tasks without forgetting the old ones.
multimodal continual graph learning with.quote: In order for continually adapting to new tasks without forgetting the old ones, our MSCGL model explores a new strategy with joint optimization of Neural Architecture Search (NAS) and Group Sparse Regularization (GSR) across different tasks.

multimodal continual graph learning with.subject: MSCGL
multimodal continual graph learning with.claim: Empirical experiments indicate that both the architectures and weight sharing across different tasks play important roles in affecting the model performances.
multimodal continual graph learning with.quote: Empirical experiments indicate that both the architectures and weight sharing across different tasks play important roles in affecting the model performances.

multimodal continual graph learning with.subject: existing works on continual graph learning
multimodal continual graph learning with.claim: Existing works on continual graph learning ignore the information from multiple modalities as well as the rich dynamic structural information hidden in the ever-changing graph data and evolving tasks.
multimodal continual graph learning with.quote: While achieving great success, existing works on continual graph learning ignore the information from multiple modalities (e.g., visual and textual features) as well as the rich dynamic structural information hidden in the ever-changing graph data and evolving tasks.

incremental prompting episodic memory pr.subject: Episodic Memory Prompts (EMP)
incremental prompting episodic memory pr.claim: The paper introduces Episodic Memory Prompts (EMP) to explicitly retain learned task-specific knowledge in lifelong event detection.
incremental prompting episodic memory pr.quote: In this paper, we introduce Episodic Memory Prompts (EMP) to explicitly retain the learned task-specific knowledge.

incremental prompting episodic memory pr.subject: Episodic Memory Prompts (EMP)
incremental prompting episodic memory pr.claim: The method adopts continuous prompts for each task that are optimized to instruct model prediction and learn event-specific representations.
incremental prompting episodic memory pr.quote: Our method adopts continuous prompt for each task and they are optimized to instruct the model prediction and learn event-specific representation.

incremental prompting episodic memory pr.subject: Episodic Memory Prompts (EMP)
incremental prompting episodic memory pr.claim: The EMPs learned in previous tasks are carried along with the model in subsequent tasks to serve as a memory module that retains old knowledge and transfers it to new tasks.
incremental prompting episodic memory pr.quote: The EMPs learned in previous tasks are carried along with the model in subsequent tasks, and can serve as a memory module that keeps the old knowledge and transferring to new tasks.

incremental prompting episodic memory pr.subject: Episodic Memory Prompts (EMP)
incremental prompting episodic memory pr.claim: Experiment results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
incremental prompting episodic memory pr.quote: Experiment results demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

incremental prompting episodic memory pr.subject: Lifelong event detection
incremental prompting episodic memory pr.claim: A critical challenge in lifelong event detection is that the model would catastrophically forget old types when continually trained on new data.
incremental prompting episodic memory pr.quote: One critical challenge is that the model would catastrophically forget old types when continually trained on new data.

dualprompt complementary prompting for r.subject: DualPrompt
dualprompt complementary prompting for r.claim: DualPrompt is a framework that learns a tiny set of parameters, called prompts, to instruct a pre-trained model to learn tasks sequentially without buffering past examples.
dualprompt complementary prompting for r.quote: In this work, we present a simple yet effective framework, DualPrompt, which learns a tiny set of parameters, called prompts, to properly instruct a pre-trained model to learn tasks arriving sequentially without buffering past examples.

dualprompt complementary prompting for r.subject: DualPrompt
dualprompt complementary prompting for r.claim: DualPrompt consistently sets state-of-the-art performance under the challenging class-incremental setting.
dualprompt complementary prompting for r.quote: With extensive experimental validation, DualPrompt consistently sets state-of-the-art performance under the challenging class-incremental setting.

dualprompt complementary prompting for r.subject: DualPrompt
dualprompt complementary prompting for r.claim: DualPrompt outperforms recent advanced continual learning methods with relatively large buffer sizes.
dualprompt complementary prompting for r.quote: In particular, DualPrompt outperforms recent advanced continual learning methods with relatively large buffer sizes.

dualprompt complementary prompting for r.subject: Split ImageNet-R
dualprompt complementary prompting for r.claim: The authors introduce Split ImageNet-R as a more challenging benchmark to help generalize rehearsal-free continual learning research.
dualprompt complementary prompting for r.quote: We also introduce a more challenging benchmark, Split ImageNet-R, to help generalize rehearsal-free continual learning research.

dualprompt complementary prompting for r.subject: Top-performing methods
dualprompt complementary prompting for r.claim: Top-performing methods usually require a rehearsal buffer to store past pristine examples, which limits their practical value due to privacy and memory constraints.
dualprompt complementary prompting for r.quote: Top-performing methods usually require a rehearsal buffer to store past pristine examples for experience replay, which, however, limits their practical value due to privacy and memory constraints.

ai autonomy self initiated open world co.subject: SOLA
ai autonomy self initiated open world co.claim: The paper proposes a framework called SOLA for the learning paradigm of self-initiated open-world continual learning and adaptation.
ai autonomy self initiated open world co.quote: This paper proposes a framework (called SOLA) for this learning paradigm to promote the research of building autonomous and continual learning enabled AI agents.

ai autonomy self initiated open world co.subject: SOLA
ai autonomy self initiated open world co.claim: An implemented agent is described to show the feasibility of the proposed framework.
ai autonomy self initiated open world co.quote: To show feasibility, an implemented agent is also described.

ai autonomy self initiated open world co.subject: AI agents
ai autonomy self initiated open world co.claim: Current AI agents are often retrained offline periodically on the initiation of human engineers rather than learning continually in a self-motivated and self-initiated manner.
ai autonomy self initiated open world co.quote: As more and more AI agents are used in practice, it is time to think about how to make these agents fully autonomous so that they can (1) learn by themselves continually in a self-motivated and self-initiated manner rather than being retrained offline periodically on the initiation of human engineers and (2) accommodate or adapt to unexpected or novel circumstances.

graph lifelong learning a survey.subject: Most graph learning methods
graph lifelong learning a survey.claim: Most graph learning methods assume that the graph is static and its complete structure is known during training, which limits their applicability to problems where the graph grows over time or new tasks emerge incrementally.
graph lifelong learning a survey.quote: Most graph learning methods assume that the graph is static and its complete structure is known during training. This limits their applicability since they cannot be applied to problems where the underlying graph grows over time and/or new tasks emerge incrementally.

graph lifelong learning a survey.subject: Lifelong learning methods
graph lifelong learning a survey.claim: Lifelong learning methods for regular domains like images and text cannot be directly applied to continuously evolving graph data due to its irregular structure.
graph lifelong learning a survey.quote: Lifelong learning methods that enable continuous learning in regular domains like images and text cannot be directly applied to continuously evolving graph data, due to its irregular structure.

graph lifelong learning a survey.subject: Graph lifelong learning
graph lifelong learning a survey.claim: Graph lifelong learning is gaining attention from the research community because it can learn graphs continuously and accommodate new information while retaining previously learned knowledge.
graph lifelong learning a survey.quote: Such applications require a lifelong learning approach that can learn the graph continuously and accommodate new information whilst retaining previously learned knowledge. ... As a result, graph lifelong learning is gaining attention from the research community.

graph lifelong learning a survey.subject: Graph Lifelong Learning: A Survey
graph lifelong learning a survey.claim: This survey paper provides a comprehensive overview of recent advancements in graph lifelong learning, including the categorization of existing methods, and the discussions of potential applications and open research problems.
graph lifelong learning a survey.quote: This survey paper provides a comprehensive overview of recent advancements in graph lifelong learning, including the categorization of existing methods, and the discussions of potential applications and open research problems.

transformers in time series a survey.subject: Transformers
transformers in time series a survey.claim: Transformers have achieved superior performances in many tasks in natural language processing and computer vision, which also triggered great interest in the time series community.
transformers in time series a survey.quote: Transformers have achieved superior performances in many tasks in natural language processing and computer vision, which also triggered great interest in the time series community.

transformers in time series a survey.subject: Transformers
transformers in time series a survey.claim: The ability to capture long-range dependencies and interactions is especially attractive for time series modeling.
transformers in time series a survey.quote: Among multiple advantages of Transformers, the ability to capture long-range dependencies and interactions is especially attractive for time series modeling, leading to exciting progress in various time series applications.

transformers in time series a survey.subject: Time series Transformers
transformers in time series a survey.claim: The paper summarizes the adaptations and modifications that have been made to Transformers in order to accommodate the challenges in time series analysis from the perspective of network structure.
transformers in time series a survey.quote: From the perspective of network structure, we summarize the adaptations and modifications that have been made to Transformers in order to accommodate the challenges in time series analysis.

transformers in time series a survey.subject: Time series Transformers
transformers in time series a survey.claim: The paper categorizes time series Transformers based on common tasks including forecasting, anomaly detection, and classification from the perspective of applications.
transformers in time series a survey.quote: From the perspective of applications, we categorize time series Transformers based on common tasks including forecasting, anomaly detection, and classification.

transformers in time series a survey.subject: Time series Transformers
transformers in time series a survey.claim: The authors perform robust analysis, model size analysis, and seasonal-trend decomposition analysis to study how Transformers perform in time series.
transformers in time series a survey.quote: Empirically, we perform robust analysis, model size analysis, and seasonal-trend decomposition analysis to study how Transformers perform in time series.

transformers in time series a survey.subject: Time series Transformers
transformers in time series a survey.claim: The paper highlights the limitations of Transformer schemes for time series modeling.
transformers in time series a survey.quote: In this paper, we systematically review Transformer schemes for time series modeling by highlighting their strengths as well as limitations.

improving pedestrian prediction models w.subject: self-supervised continual learning framework
improving pedestrian prediction models w.claim: The paper introduces a self-supervised continual learning framework to improve data-driven pedestrian prediction models online across various scenarios continuously.
improving pedestrian prediction models w.quote: This letter introduces a self-supervised continual learning framework to improve data-driven pedestrian prediction models online across various scenarios continuously.

improving pedestrian prediction models w.subject: self-supervised continual learning framework
improving pedestrian prediction models w.claim: The framework exploits online streams of pedestrian data from the robot’s detection and tracking pipeline to refine the prediction model and its performance in unseen scenarios.
improving pedestrian prediction models w.quote: In particular, we exploit online streams of pedestrian data, commonly available from the robot’s detection and tracking pipeline, to refine the prediction model and its performance in unseen scenarios.

improving pedestrian prediction models w.subject: self-supervised continual learning framework
improving pedestrian prediction models w.claim: To avoid catastrophic forgetting, the framework includes a regularization loss to penalize changes of model parameters important for previous scenarios and retrains on a set of previous examples.
improving pedestrian prediction models w.quote: To avoid the forgetting of previously learned concepts, a problem known as catastrophic forgetting, our framework includes a regularization loss to penalize changes of model parameters that are important for previous scenarios and retrains on a set of previous examples to retain past knowledge.

improving pedestrian prediction models w.subject: self-supervised continual learning framework
improving pedestrian prediction models w.claim: Experimental results on real and simulation data show that the approach improves prediction performance in unseen scenarios while retaining knowledge from seen scenarios compared to naively training the prediction model online.
improving pedestrian prediction models w.quote: Experimental results on real and simulation data show that our approach can improve prediction performance in unseen scenarios while retaining knowledge from seen scenarios when compared to naively training the prediction model online.

reinforced incremental and cross lingual.subject: FinEvent
reinforced incremental and cross lingual.claim: FinEvent is a novel reinforced, incremental and cross-lingual social event detection architecture presented for streaming social messages.
reinforced incremental and cross lingual.quote: In this paper, we present a novel reinForced, incremental and cross-lingual social Event detection architecture, namely FinEvent, from streaming social messages.

reinforced incremental and cross lingual.subject: reinforced weighted multi-relational graph neural network framework
reinforced incremental and cross lingual.claim: A new reinforced weighted multi-relational graph neural network framework is proposed using a Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning algorithm to select optimal aggregation thresholds across different relations/edges to learn social message embeddings.
reinforced incremental and cross lingual.quote: Second, we propose a new reinforced weighted multi-relational graph neural network framework by using a Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning algorithm to select optimal aggregation thresholds across different relations/edges to learn social message embeddings.

reinforced incremental and cross lingual.subject: balanced sampling strategy guided Contrastive Learning mechanism
reinforced incremental and cross lingual.claim: A balanced sampling strategy guided Contrastive Learning mechanism is designed for incremental social message representation learning to solve the long-tail problem in social event detection.
reinforced incremental and cross lingual.quote: To solve the long-tail problem in social event detection, a balanced sampling strategy guided Contrastive Learning mechanism is designed for incremental social message representation learning.

reinforced incremental and cross lingual.subject: Deep Reinforcement Learning guided density-based spatial clustering model
reinforced incremental and cross lingual.claim: A new Deep Reinforcement Learning guided density-based spatial clustering model is designed to select the optimal minimum number of samples required to form a cluster and optimal minimum distance between two clusters in social event detection tasks.
reinforced incremental and cross lingual.quote: Third, a new Deep Reinforcement Learning guided density-based spatial clustering model is designed to select the optimal minimum number of samples required to form a cluster and optimal minimum distance between two clusters in social event detection tasks.

reinforced incremental and cross lingual.subject: FinEvent
reinforced incremental and cross lingual.claim: Experiments on Twitter streams demonstrate that FinEvent achieves significant and consistent improvements in model quality with 14%–118%, 8%–170%, and 2%–21% increases in performance on offline, online, and cross-lingual social event detection tasks, respectively.
reinforced incremental and cross lingual.quote: We conduct extensive experiments to evaluate the FinEvent on Twitter streams, demonstrating a significant and consistent improvement in model quality with 14%–118%, 8%–170%, and 2%–21% increases in performance on offline, online, and cross-lingual social event detection tasks.

reinforced incremental and cross lingual.subject: existing event detection methods
reinforced incremental and cross lingual.claim: Existing event detection methods towards streaming social messages are generally confronted with ambiguous events features, dispersive text contents, and multiple languages, resulting in low accuracy and generalization ability.
reinforced incremental and cross lingual.quote: However, the challenge is that the existing event detection methods towards streaming social messages are generally confronted with ambiguous events features, dispersive text contents, and multiple languages, and hence result in low accuracy and generalization ability.

graph few shot class incremental learnin.subject: Graph Pseudo Incremental Learning
graph few shot class incremental learnin.claim: The authors put forward a Graph Pseudo Incremental Learning paradigm by sampling tasks recurrently from the base classes to produce an arbitrary number of training episodes.
graph few shot class incremental learnin.quote: Towards that purpose, we put forward a Graph Pseudo Incremental Learning paradigm by sampling tasks recurrently from the base classes, so as to produce an arbitrary number of training episodes for our model to practice the incremental learning skill.

graph few shot class incremental learnin.subject: HAG-Meta
graph few shot class incremental learnin.claim: The authors design a Hierarchical-Attention-based Graph Meta-learning framework named HAG-Meta from an optimization perspective.
graph few shot class incremental learnin.quote: Furthermore, we design a Hierarchical-Attention-based Graph Meta-learning framework, HAG-Meta from an optimization perspective.

graph few shot class incremental learnin.subject: HAG-Meta
graph few shot class incremental learnin.claim: A task-sensitive regularizer calculated from task-level attention and node class prototypes is presented to mitigate overfitting onto either novel or base classes.
graph few shot class incremental learnin.quote: We present a task-sensitive regularizer calculated from task-level attention and node class prototypes to mitigate overfitting onto either novel or base classes.

graph few shot class incremental learnin.subject: HAG-Meta
graph few shot class incremental learnin.claim: A node-level attention module is added to adjust the prototype representation to employ topological knowledge.
graph few shot class incremental learnin.quote: To employ the topological knowledge, we add a node-level attention module to adjust the prototype representation.

graph few shot class incremental learnin.subject: HAG-Meta
graph few shot class incremental learnin.claim: The model achieves greater stability of old knowledge consolidation and acquires advantageous adaptability to new knowledge with very limited data samples.
graph few shot class incremental learnin.quote: Our model not only achieves greater stability of old knowledge consolidation, but also acquires advantageous adaptability to new knowledge with very limited data samples.

graph few shot class incremental learnin.subject: HAG-Meta
graph few shot class incremental learnin.claim: Extensive experiments on Amazon-clothing, Reddit, and DBLP show that the framework demonstrates remarkable advantages in comparison with the baseline and other related state-of-the-art methods.
graph few shot class incremental learnin.quote: Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets, including Amazon-clothing, Reddit, and DBLP, show that our framework demonstrates remarkable advantages in comparison with the baseline and other related state-of-the-art methods.

fairness and accuracy in horizontal fede.subject: FedFa
fairness and accuracy in horizontal fede.claim: The paper proposes an algorithm named FedFa to achieve more fairness and accuracy in horizontal federated learning.
fairness and accuracy in horizontal fede.quote: This paper proposes an algorithm to achieve more fairness and accuracy in horizontal federated learning (FedFa).

fairness and accuracy in horizontal fede.subject: FedFa
fairness and accuracy in horizontal fede.claim: FedFa introduces an optimization scheme that employs a double momentum gradient to accelerate the convergence rate of the model.
fairness and accuracy in horizontal fede.quote: It introduces an optimization scheme that employs a double momentum gradient, thereby accelerating the convergence rate of the model.

fairness and accuracy in horizontal fede.subject: FedFa
fairness and accuracy in horizontal fede.claim: FedFa proposes a weight selection algorithm that combines the information quantity of training accuracy and training frequency to measure weights for fairer aggregation at the server.
fairness and accuracy in horizontal fede.quote: An appropriate weight selection algorithm that combines the information quantity of training accuracy and training frequency to measure the weights is proposed. This process assists clients in aggregating at the server with a more fair weighting.

fairness and accuracy in horizontal fede.subject: FedFa
fairness and accuracy in horizontal fede.claim: The proposed FedFa algorithm outperforms the baseline algorithm in terms of accuracy and fairness.
fairness and accuracy in horizontal fede.quote: Our results show that the proposed FedFa algorithm outperforms the baseline algorithm in terms of accuracy and fairness.

continual learning for multivariate time.subject: Proposed approach with task-specific generative models and GNN conditioning module
continual learning for multivariate time.claim: The authors learn task-specific generative models and classifiers to augment data for target tasks and propose a novel conditioning module based on graph neural networks to aid a standard recurrent neural network.
continual learning for multivariate time.quote: To this end, we learn task-specific generative models and classifiers, and use these to augment data for target tasks. Since the input dimensions across tasks vary, we propose a novel conditioning module based on graph neural networks to aid a standard recurrent neural network.

continual learning for multivariate time.subject: Proposed approach
continual learning for multivariate time.claim: It is possible to significantly enhance the performance on future and previous tasks while learning continuously from variable input dimension tasks without storing data.
continual learning for multivariate time.quote: We demonstrate that it is possible to significantly enhance the performance on future and previous tasks while learning continuously from VID tasks without storing data.

continual learning for multivariate time.subject: Existing continual learning methods
continual learning for multivariate time.claim: Existing continual learning methods do not take into account variability in input dimensions arising due to different subsets of sensors being available across tasks and struggle to adapt to such variable input dimension tasks.
continual learning for multivariate time.quote: We note that existing continual learning methods do not take into account variability in input dimensions arising due to different subsets of sensors being available across tasks, and struggle to adapt to such variable input dimensions (VID) tasks.

hierarchical prototype networks for cont.subject: Hierarchical Prototype Networks (HPNs)
hierarchical prototype networks for cont.claim: HPNs extract different levels of abstract knowledge in the form of prototypes to represent the continuously expanded graphs.
hierarchical prototype networks for cont.quote: To this end, we present Hierarchical Prototype Networks (HPNs) which extract different levels of abstract knowledge in the form of prototypes to represent the continuously expanded graphs.

hierarchical prototype networks for cont.subject: Atomic Feature Extractors (AFEs)
hierarchical prototype networks for cont.claim: AFEs are leveraged to encode both the elemental attribute information and the topological structure of the target node.
hierarchical prototype networks for cont.quote: Specifically, we first leverage a set of Atomic Feature Extractors (AFEs) to encode both the elemental attribute information and the topological structure of the target node.

hierarchical prototype networks for cont.subject: Hierarchical Prototype Networks (HPNs)
hierarchical prototype networks for cont.claim: The memory consumption of HPNs is bounded regardless of how many tasks are encountered.
hierarchical prototype networks for cont.quote: Theoretically, we first demonstrate that the memory consumption of HPNs is bounded regardless of how many tasks are encountered.

hierarchical prototype networks for cont.subject: Hierarchical Prototype Networks (HPNs)
hierarchical prototype networks for cont.claim: Under mild constraints, learning new tasks will not alter the prototypes matched to previous data, thereby eliminating the forgetting problem.
hierarchical prototype networks for cont.quote: Then, we prove that under mild constraints, learning new tasks will not alter the prototypes matched to previous data, thereby eliminating the forgetting problem.

hierarchical prototype networks for cont.subject: Hierarchical Prototype Networks (HPNs)
hierarchical prototype networks for cont.claim: HPNs outperform state-of-the-art baseline techniques and consume relatively less memory on five datasets.
hierarchical prototype networks for cont.quote: The theoretical results are supported by experiments on five datasets, showing that HPNs not only outperform state-of-the-art baseline techniques but also consume relatively less memory.

hierarchical prototype networks for cont.subject: Existing methods
hierarchical prototype networks for cont.claim: Existing methods either ignore the rich topological information or sacrifice plasticity for stability.
hierarchical prototype networks for cont.quote: Existing methods either ignore the rich topological information or sacrifice plasticity for stability.

lifelong vehicle trajectory prediction f.subject: divergence measurement method based on conditional Kullback-Leibler divergence
lifelong vehicle trajectory prediction f.claim: A divergence measurement method based on conditional Kullback-Leibler divergence is proposed to evaluate spatiotemporal dependency difference among varied driving circumstances.
lifelong vehicle trajectory prediction f.quote: In this paper, a divergence measurement method based on conditional Kullback-Leibler divergence is proposed first to evaluate spatiotemporal dependency difference among varied driving circumstances.

lifelong vehicle trajectory prediction f.subject: lifelong vehicle trajectory prediction framework
lifelong vehicle trajectory prediction f.claim: A novel lifelong vehicle trajectory prediction framework is developed based on generative replay, consisting of a conditional generation model and a vehicle trajectory prediction model.
lifelong vehicle trajectory prediction f.quote: Then based on generative replay, a novel lifelong vehicle trajectory prediction framework is developed. The framework consists of a conditional generation model and a vehicle trajectory prediction model.

lifelong vehicle trajectory prediction f.subject: conditional generation model
lifelong vehicle trajectory prediction f.claim: The conditional generation model is a generative adversarial network conditioned on position configuration of vehicles.
lifelong vehicle trajectory prediction f.quote: The conditional generation model is a generative adversarial network conditioned on position configuration of vehicles.

lifelong vehicle trajectory prediction f.subject: lifelong vehicle trajectory prediction framework
lifelong vehicle trajectory prediction f.claim: The proposed framework exhibits lifelong learning ability and achieves consistent performance on all tasks despite spatiotemporal dependency divergence.
lifelong vehicle trajectory prediction f.quote: Even though these divergence, the proposed framework exhibits lifelong learning ability and achieves consistent performance on all tasks.

graph structure aware contrastive knowle.subject: Graph Structure Aware Contrastive Knowledge Distillation
graph structure aware contrastive knowle.claim: The authors develop a novel Graph Structure Aware Contrastive Knowledge Distillation for Incremental Learning in recommender systems, tailored to focus on the rich relational information in the recommendation context.
graph structure aware contrastive knowle.quote: In this work, we develop a novel Graph Structure Aware Contrastive Knowledge Distillation for Incremental Learning in recommender systems, which is tailored to focus on the rich relational information in the recommendation context.

graph structure aware contrastive knowle.subject: Graph Structure Aware Contrastive Knowledge Distillation
graph structure aware contrastive knowle.claim: The proposed method combines the contrastive distillation formulation with intermediate layer distillation to inject layer-level supervision.
graph structure aware contrastive knowle.quote: We combine the contrastive distillation formulation with intermediate layer distillation to inject layer-level supervision.

graph structure aware contrastive knowle.subject: Graph Structure Aware Contrastive Knowledge Distillation
graph structure aware contrastive knowle.claim: The proposed distillation framework demonstrates consistent improvement over state-of-the-art alternatives on four commonly used datasets.
graph structure aware contrastive knowle.quote: We demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed distillation framework for GNN based recommendation systems on four commonly used datasets, showing consistent improvement over state-of-the-art alternatives.

graph structure aware contrastive knowle.subject: GNN based recommender models
graph structure aware contrastive knowle.claim: It is difficult to perform frequent updates to provide the most up-to-date recommendations due to the ever-growing volume of online information and the high computational complexity of training GNNs.
graph structure aware contrastive knowle.quote: However, with the ever-growing volume of online information and the high computational complexity of training GNNs, it is difficult to perform frequent updates to provide the most up-to-date recommendations.

incremental graph convolutional network.subject: IGCN
incremental graph convolutional network.claim: IGCN is a pure graph convolutional network based method to update GNN models when new user-item interactions are available.
incremental graph convolutional network.quote: To this end, we propose the incremental graph convolutional network (IGCN) --- a pure graph convolutional network (GCN) based method to update GNN models when new user-item interactions are available.

incremental graph convolutional network.subject: IGCN
incremental graph convolutional network.claim: IGCN consists of a historical feature generation layer that uses model agnostic meta-learning and a temporal feature learning layer that uses graph convolutional network and incremental temporal convolutional network.
incremental graph convolutional network.quote: IGCN consists of two main components: 1) a historical feature generation layer, which generates the initial user/item embedding via model agnostic meta-learning and ensures good initial states and fast model adaptation; 2) a temporal feature learning layer, which first aggregates the features from local neighborhood to update the embedding of each user/item within each subgraph via graph convoluti

incremental graph convolutional network.subject: IGCN
incremental graph convolutional network.claim: IGCN can outperform state-of-the-art CF algorithms in sequential recommendation tasks.
incremental graph convolutional network.quote: Experimental studies on real-world datasets show that IGCN can outperform state-of-the-art CF algorithms in sequential recommendation tasks.

incremental graph convolutional network.subject: periodic retraining
incremental graph convolutional network.claim: Naive solutions such as periodic retraining lose important temporal information and are computationally expensive.
incremental graph convolutional network.quote: Naive solutions such as periodic retraining lose important temporal information and are computationally expensive.

incremental graph convolutional network.subject: recurrent neural networks
incremental graph convolutional network.claim: Recent works that leverage recurrent neural networks to keep GNN up-to-date may suffer from the "catastrophic forgetting'' issue, and experience a cold start with new users and items.
incremental graph convolutional network.quote: Recent works that leverage recurrent neural networks to keep GNN up-to-date may suffer from the "catastrophic forgetting'' issue, and experience a cold start with new users and items.

structure aware experience replay for in.subject: Structure Aware Experience Replay framework
structure aware experience replay for in.claim: The paper presents a novel framework for incrementally training GNN-based models that uses an experience replay technique built on a structurally aware reservoir sampling method.
structure aware experience replay for in.quote: In this work, we present a novel framework for incrementally training GNN-based models. Our framework takes advantage of an experience reply technique built on top of a structurally aware reservoir sampling method tailored for this setting.

structure aware experience replay for in.subject: Structure Aware Experience Replay framework
structure aware experience replay for in.claim: The framework addresses catastrophic forgetting by allowing the model to preserve its understanding of users' long-term behavioral patterns while adapting to new trends.
structure aware experience replay for in.quote: This framework addresses catastrophic forgetting, allowing the model to preserve its understanding of users' long-term behavioral patterns while adapting to new trends.

structure aware experience replay for in.subject: Structure Aware Experience Replay framework
structure aware experience replay for in.claim: Experiments demonstrate the superior performance of the framework on numerous datasets when combined with state-of-the-art GNN-based models.
structure aware experience replay for in.quote: Our experiments demonstrate the superior performance of our framework on numerous datasets when combined with state-of-the-art GNN-based models.

structure aware experience replay for in.subject: state-of-the-art graph neural network (GNN) based models
structure aware experience replay for in.claim: It is infeasible to train state-of-the-art GNN-based models from scratch with every new set of interactions due to high computational cost.
structure aware experience replay for in.quote: Given the high computational cost of training state-of-the-art graph neural network (GNN) based models, it is infeasible to train them from scratch with every new set of interactions.

towards continual knowledge learning of.subject: Continual Knowledge Learning (CKL)
towards continual knowledge learning of.claim: The authors formulate a new continual learning problem called Continual Knowledge Learning (CKL) to address the maintenance of ever-changing Large Language Models.
towards continual knowledge learning of.quote: To push the community towards better maintenance of ever-changing LMs, we formulate a new continual learning (CL) problem called Continual Knowledge Learning (CKL).

towards continual knowledge learning of.subject: CKL Benchmark
towards continual knowledge learning of.claim: The authors construct a new benchmark and metric to quantify the retention of time-invariant world knowledge, the update of outdated knowledge, and the acquisition of new knowledge.
towards continual knowledge learning of.quote: We construct a new benchmark and metric to quantify the retention of time-invariant world knowledge, the update of outdated knowledge, and the acquisition of new knowledge.

towards continual knowledge learning of.subject: CKL
towards continual knowledge learning of.claim: CKL exhibits unique challenges not addressed in previous continual learning setups, where parameter expansion is necessary to reliably retain and learn knowledge simultaneously.
towards continual knowledge learning of.quote: Through extensive experiments, we find that CKL exhibits unique challenges that are not addressed in previous CL setups, where parameter expansion is necessary to reliably retain and learn knowledge simultaneously.

towards continual knowledge learning of.subject: Large Language Models
towards continual knowledge learning of.claim: It is non-trivial to avoid catastrophic forgetting and reliably acquire new knowledge while preserving invariant knowledge in LMs as world knowledge becomes outdated.
towards continual knowledge learning of.quote: In real-world scenarios, the world knowledge stored in the LMs can quickly become outdated as the world changes, but it is non-trivial to avoid catastrophic forgetting and reliably acquire new knowledge while preserving invariant knowledge.

continual multi agent interaction behavi.subject: multi-agent interaction behavior prediction framework with a graph-neural-network-based conditional generative memory sy
continual multi agent interaction behavi.claim: The authors propose a multi-agent interaction behavior prediction framework with a graph-neural-network-based conditional generative memory system to mitigate catastrophic forgetting.
continual multi agent interaction behavi.quote: Motivated by the generative replay methods in continual learning literature, we propose a multi-agent interaction behavior prediction framework with a graph-neural-network-based conditional generative memory system to mitigate catastrophic forgetting.

continual multi agent interaction behavi.subject: several approaches in literature
continual multi agent interaction behavi.claim: Several approaches in the literature indeed suffer from catastrophic forgetting.
continual multi agent interaction behavi.quote: We empirically show that several approaches in literature indeed suffer from catastrophic forgetting, and our approach succeeds in maintaining a low prediction error when datasets come in a sequential way.

continual multi agent interaction behavi.subject: multi-agent interaction behavior prediction framework with a graph-neural-network-based conditional generative memory sy
continual multi agent interaction behavi.claim: The proposed approach succeeds in maintaining a low prediction error when datasets come in a sequential way.
continual multi agent interaction behavi.quote: We empirically show that several approaches in literature indeed suffer from catastrophic forgetting, and our approach succeeds in maintaining a low prediction error when datasets come in a sequential way.

continual multi agent interaction behavi.subject: multi-agent interaction behavior prediction framework with a graph-neural-network-based conditional generative memory sy
continual multi agent interaction behavi.claim: An ablation analysis shows the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
continual multi agent interaction behavi.quote: We also conduct an ablation analysis to show the effectiveness of our proposed approach.

airloop lifelong loop closure detection.subject: AirLoop
airloop lifelong loop closure detection.claim: AirLoop is a method that leverages techniques from lifelong learning to minimize forgetting when training loop closure detection models incrementally.
airloop lifelong loop closure detection.quote: In this paper, we present AirLoop, a method that leverages techniques from lifelong learning to minimize forgetting when training loop closure detection models incrementally.

airloop lifelong loop closure detection.subject: AirLoop
airloop lifelong loop closure detection.claim: AirLoop is one of the first works to achieve lifelong learning of deep loop closure detectors.
airloop lifelong loop closure detection.quote: To the best of our knowledge, AirLoop is one of the first works to achieve lifelong learning of deep loop closure detectors.

airloop lifelong loop closure detection.subject: CNN-based approaches
airloop lifelong loop closure detection.claim: Simply finetuning the model on new data is infeasible since it may cause the model's performance on previously learned data to degrade over time, which is also known as the problem of catastrophic forgetting.
airloop lifelong loop closure detection.quote: Nevertheless, simply finetuning the model on new data is infeasible since it may cause the model's performance on previously learned data to degrade over time, which is also known as the problem of catastrophic forgetting.

airloop lifelong loop closure detection.subject: AirLoop
airloop lifelong loop closure detection.claim: The effectiveness of AirLoop is experimentally demonstrated on TartanAir, Nordland, and RobotCar datasets.
airloop lifelong loop closure detection.quote: We experimentally demonstrate the effectiveness of AirLoop on TartanAir, Nordland, and RobotCar datasets.

spatio temporal event forecasting using.subject: novel feature learning model
spatio temporal event forecasting using.claim: The article proposes a novel feature learning model that concurrently addresses geographical hierarchies, hierarchical missing values, structured feature sparsity, and online update difficulties.
spatio temporal event forecasting using.quote: This article proposes a novel feature learning model that concurrently addresses all the above challenges.

spatio temporal event forecasting using.subject: Nth-order strong hierarchy and fused-overlapping group Lasso
spatio temporal event forecasting using.claim: A novel feature learning model based on an Nth-order strong hierarchy and fused-overlapping group Lasso is proposed to handle correlations amidst structured feature sets and deal with missing values among coupled features.
spatio temporal event forecasting using.quote: To handle the correlations amidst structured feature sets and deal with missing values among the coupled features, we propose a novel feature learning model based on an Nth-order strong hierarchy and fused-overlapping group Lasso.

spatio temporal event forecasting using.subject: online learning algorithm
spatio temporal event forecasting using.claim: An online learning algorithm is formulated and active set techniques are leveraged to enable real-time model updates when new patterns of missing features appear.
spatio temporal event forecasting using.quote: More importantly, to enable the model update in real time, the online learning algorithm is formulated and active set techniques are leveraged to resolve the crucial challenge when new patterns of missing features appear in real time.

spatio temporal event forecasting using.subject: proposed models
spatio temporal event forecasting using.claim: Extensive experiments on 10 datasets in different domains demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed models.
spatio temporal event forecasting using.quote: Extensive experiments on 10 datasets in different domains demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed models.

spatio temporal event forecasting using.subject: Traditional forecasting methods
spatio temporal event forecasting using.claim: Traditional forecasting methods based on a single data source find it hard to cover all societal aspects comprehensively, thus limiting model performance.
spatio temporal event forecasting using.quote: Traditional forecasting methods based on a single data source find it hard to cover all these aspects comprehensively, thus limiting model performance.

spatio temporal event forecasting using.subject: Multi-source event forecasting
spatio temporal event forecasting using.claim: Multi-source event forecasting still suffers from challenges including geographical hierarchies in multi-source data features, hierarchical missing values, characterization of structured feature sparsity, and difficulty in model’s online update with incomplete multiple sources.
spatio temporal event forecasting using.quote: Multi-source event forecasting has proven promising but still suffers from several challenges, including (1) geographical hierarchies in multi-source data features, (2) hierarchical missing values, (3) characterization of structured feature sparsity, and (4) difficulty in model’s online update with incomplete multiple sources.

causal incremental graph convolution for.subject: Causal Incremental Graph Convolution (IGC)
causal incremental graph convolution for.claim: The authors propose a causal incremental graph convolution (IGC) approach consisting of IGC and colliding effect distillation (CED) operators to estimate the output of full graph convolution.
causal incremental graph convolution for.quote: Toward the goal, we propose a causal incremental graph convolution (IGC) approach, which consists of two new operators named IGC and colliding effect distillation (CED) to estimate the output of full graph convolution.

causal incremental graph convolution for.subject: IGC
causal incremental graph convolution for.claim: The IGC module is designed to combine old representations and the incremental graph to fuse long- and short-term preference signals.
causal incremental graph convolution for.quote: In particular, we devise simple and effective modules for IGC to ingeniously combine the old representations and the incremental graph and effectively fuse the long- and short-term preference signals.

causal incremental graph convolution for.subject: colliding effect distillation (CED)
causal incremental graph convolution for.claim: CED estimates the causal effect of new data on the representation of inactive nodes through the control of their collider to avoid the out-of-date issue.
causal incremental graph convolution for.quote: CED aims to avoid the out-of-date issue of inactive nodes that are not in the incremental graph, which connects the new data with inactive nodes through causal inference. In particular, CED estimates the causal effect of new data on the representation of inactive nodes through the control of their collider.

causal incremental graph convolution for.subject: Causal Incremental Graph Convolution (IGC)
causal incremental graph convolution for.claim: Experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves both accuracy gains and significant speed-ups over existing retraining mechanisms.
causal incremental graph convolution for.quote: Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate both accuracy gains and significant speed-ups over the existing retraining mechanism.

causal incremental graph convolution for.subject: GCN-based recommender models
causal incremental graph convolution for.claim: Retraining GCN-based recommender models is nontrivial because interaction data participates in both the graph structure and the loss function, while the old graph structure cannot be used for updating.
causal incremental graph convolution for.quote: This is nontrivial to achieve since the interaction data participates in both the graph structure for model construction and the loss function for model learning, whereas the old graph structure is not allowed to use in model updating.

lil lightweight incremental learning app.subject: LIL
lil lightweight incremental learning app.claim: A lightweight incremental learning approach (LIL) is proposed for remote sensing image scene classification.
lil lightweight incremental learning app.quote: In this article, a lightweight incremental learning approach (LIL) is proposed for remote sensing image scene classification.

lil lightweight incremental learning app.subject: LIL
lil lightweight incremental learning app.claim: The method replaces the role of the feature extractor with extracting features of a single task instead of task-sharing features of all tasks to lighten the backbone.
lil lightweight incremental learning app.quote: We replace the role of the feature extractor with extracting features of a single task instead of task-sharing features of all tasks to lighten the backbone.

lil lightweight incremental learning app.subject: FTM
lil lightweight incremental learning app.claim: A light feature transfer module (FTM) is proposed to realize the alignment of data distributions between different tasks in the feature domain.
lil lightweight incremental learning app.quote: In addition, we propose a light feature transfer module (FTM) to realize the alignment of data distributions between different tasks in the feature domain.

lil lightweight incremental learning app.subject: LIL
lil lightweight incremental learning app.claim: Dual-constraint loss with knowledge distillation and adversarial learning is introduced to promote the mapping and alignment of data distributions at both the feature level and the semantic level.
lil lightweight incremental learning app.quote: Furthermore, dual-constraint loss with knowledge distillation and adversarial learning is introduced to promote the mapping and alignment of data distributions at both the feature level and the semantic level.

lil lightweight incremental learning app.subject: LIL

hugginggpt solving ai tasks with chatgpt.quote: Based on this philosophy, we present HuggingGPT, an LLM-powered agent that leverages LLMs (e.g., ChatGPT) to connect various AI models in machine learning communities (e.g., Hugging Face) to solve AI tasks.

hugginggpt solving ai tasks with chatgpt.subject: HuggingGPT
hugginggpt solving ai tasks with chatgpt.claim: HuggingGPT uses ChatGPT to conduct task planning, select models based on function descriptions, execute subtasks, and summarize responses.
hugginggpt solving ai tasks with chatgpt.quote: Specifically, we use ChatGPT to conduct task planning when receiving a user request, select models according to their function descriptions available in Hugging Face, execute each subtask with the selected AI model, and summarize the response according to the execution results.

hugginggpt solving ai tasks with chatgpt.subject: HuggingGPT
hugginggpt solving ai tasks with chatgpt.claim: HuggingGPT can tackle a wide range of sophisticated AI tasks spanning different modalities and domains and achieve impressive results in language, vision, speech, and other challenging tasks.
hugginggpt solving ai tasks with chatgpt.quote: By leveraging the strong language capability of ChatGPT and abundant AI models in Hugging Face, HuggingGPT can tackle a wide range of sophisticated AI tasks spanning different modalities and domains and achieve impressive results in language, vision, speech, and other challenging tasks, which paves a new way towards the realization of artificial general intelligence.

hugginggpt solving ai tasks with chatgpt.subject: LLMs
hugginggpt solving ai tasks with chatgpt.claim: LLMs have exhibited exceptional abilities in language understanding, generation, interaction, and reasoning.
hugginggpt solving ai tasks with chatgpt.quote: Considering large language models (LLMs) have exhibited exceptional abilities in language understanding, generation, interaction, and reasoning, we advocate that LLMs could act as a controller to manage existing AI models to solve complicated AI tasks, with language serving as a generic interface to empower this.
