cglb benchmark tasks for continual graph.subject: CGLB
cglb benchmark tasks for continual graph.claim: CGLB is a comprehensive Continual Graph Learning Benchmark curated from different public datasets that contains both node-level and graph-level tasks under task-incremental and class-incremental settings.
cglb benchmark tasks for continual graph.quote: Specifically, CGLB contains both node-level and graph-level continual graph learning tasks under task-incremental (currently widely adopted) and class-incremental (more practical, challenging, yet underexplored) settings, as well as a toolkit for training, evaluating, and visualizing different CGL methods.

cglb benchmark tasks for continual graph.subject: Continual Graph Learning
cglb benchmark tasks for continual graph.claim: Benchmark tasks are rare for Continual Graph Learning, unlike continual learning on Euclidean data which has established benchmarks and unified experimental settings.
cglb benchmark tasks for continual graph.quote: Unlike continual learning on Euclidean data ( e.g. , images, texts, etc.) that has established benchmarks and unified experimental settings, benchmark tasks are rare for Continual Graph Learning (CGL).

cglb benchmark tasks for continual graph.subject: CGLB

bmu moco bidirectional momentum update f.subject: BMU-MoCo
bmu moco bidirectional momentum update f.claim: BMU-MoCo is a novel cross-modal MoCo-based model with bidirectional momentum update proposed to overcome catastrophic forgetting and heavy resource consumption in continual video-language modeling.
bmu moco bidirectional momentum update f.quote: To overcome the challenges ( i.e. , catastrophic forgetting and heavy resource consumption) in CVLM, we propose a novel cross-modal MoCo-based model with bidirectional momentum update (BMU), termed BMU-MoCo.

bmu moco bidirectional momentum update f.subject: BMU-MoCo
bmu moco bidirectional momentum update f.claim: BMU-MoCo applies momentum update to both momentum encoders and encoders at each training step to enable the model to review learned knowledge retained in the momentum encoders.
bmu moco bidirectional momentum update f.quote: Different from the conventional MoCo, we apply the momentum update to not only momentum encoders but also encoders ( i.e. , bidirectional) at each training step, which enables the model to review the learned knowledge retained in the momentum encoders.

bmu moco bidirectional momentum update f.subject: BMU-MoCo
bmu moco bidirectional momentum update f.claim: BMU-MoCo maintains a pair of global momentum encoders initialized only at the very beginning with the same bidirectional momentum update strategy to utilize earlier knowledge.
bmu moco bidirectional momentum update f.quote: To further enhance our BMU-MoCo by utilizing earlier knowledge, we additionally maintain a pair of global momentum encoders (only initialized at the very beginning) with the same BMU strategy.

bmu moco bidirectional momentum update f.subject: BMU-MoCo
bmu moco bidirectional momentum update f.claim: BMU-MoCo remarkably outperforms recent competitors in video-text retrieval performance and forgetting rate without using any extra data or dynamic networks.
bmu moco bidirectional momentum update f.quote: Extensive results show that our BMU-MoCo remarkably outperforms recent competitors w.r.t. video-text retrieval performance and forgetting rate, even without using any extra data or dynamic networks.

bmu moco bidirectional momentum update f.subject: existing continual learning methods
bmu moco bidirectional momentum update f.claim: Existing continual learning methods that exploit extra information or dynamically extended networks cause enormous resource consumption when transferred to the CVLM setting.
bmu moco bidirectional momentum update f.quote: Although most of existing continual learning methods have achieved great success by exploiting extra information ( e.g. , memory data of past tasks) or dynamically extended networks, they cause enormous resource consumption when transferred to our CVLM setting.

bert pre training of deep bidirectional.subject: BERT
bert pre training of deep bidirectional.claim: BERT is a new language representation model designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context in all layers.
bert pre training of deep bidirectional.quote: We introduce a new language representation model called BERT, which stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers. Unlike recent language representation models (Peters et al., 2018a; Radford et al., 2018), BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context in all layers.
